addressed.change: Fixed _parse_income to reject incomes with more than 2 decimal places by checking exponent < -2 instead of silently rounding via quantize, and quantize with sufficient precision.

claims.title: income_tax accepts incomes with more than 2 decimal places instead of raising ValueError

addressed.change: use magnitude-based Decimal precision (adjusted()+margin) for parse quantize and wrap breakdown/sum/rate arithmetic in high-precision localcontext so huge incomes no longer raise InvalidOperation/ValueError
same precision fix lets scientific-notation huge incomes like 1E+30 quantize to cents instead of falsely rejecting them for decimal places

claims.title: income_tax fails for a valid income requiring more than the default 28-digit Decimal precision
